fusions.name: Snagging Pass
fusions.desc: A passing kick with barbed shoes that deals 12 damage, snags the target off its feet for a 1 second stun and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Gaffing Run
fusions.desc: Hooks an enemy up to 7 tiles away that is at or below 25% health, dealing 22 damage, up to 1.3 times that at full range, and slowing it by 40% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Dragline
fusions.desc: Lays a barbed line 6 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Barbed Pursuit
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying any affliction, your damage rises by 10%.
